passive.name: Shepherd of Souls
passive.description: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

primaryAbilities.name: Last Rites
primaryAbilities.description: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Yorick's next Attack deals an additional {{ bonusdamage }} physical damage and restores {{ qheal }} plus {{ missinghealthratio }}% of his missing Health, reduced by {{ healreduction }}% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave.

When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Dark Procession
primaryAbilities.description: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has <healing>{{ wallhealthtooltip }} Health</healing> and disappears after {{ circleduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Mourning Mist
primaryAbilities.description: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals {{ calc_healthdamage }} max Health magic damage, Slows by {{ calc_slow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds and marks champions and monsters for {{ markduration }} seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of {{ spell.yorickpassive:yorickpassiveghoulmax }}) and suffer {{ armorshred*100 }}% reduced Armor.

Yorick and his summoned units gain {{ hasteamount*100 }}% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Eulogy of the Isles
primaryAbilities.description: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with {{ yorickbigghoulhealth }} Health and {{ yorickbigghouldamage }} Magic Attack Damage plus {{ rghoulnumbers }} Mist Walkers. The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals {{ rmarkdamagepercent }}% max Health magic damage.

After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden, sending her down the nearest lane.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: Shepherd of Souls
allSpellRecords.summary: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Yorick raises a grave for every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=8, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 3, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 5, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] enemies that die near him. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave.

These graves can be used to Awaken Mist Walkers with [characterLevelInterpolation(100 → 300; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Health and [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 100; raw flags preserved) + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] Attack Damage, up to [4] in an area.
